card.title: Become What You Compete With
card.instruction: Turn comparison into imitation: adopt whatever quality seems powerful, allowing each borrowed trait to change the basis of the rivalry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cake won because it was minimalist. I'm removing half my decorations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I won for giving everyone a slice. Yours stayed behind glass.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll serve pieces twice your size. Pass me the knife.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's a queue of twenty. I cut mine small so nobody missed out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then mine will be thinner. I'll feed the queue and the people they go home to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cake won because it was minimalist. I'm removing half my decorations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I won for giving everyone a slice. Yours stayed behind glass.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll serve pieces twice your size. Pass me the knife.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's a queue of twenty. I cut mine small so nobody missed out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then mine will be thinner. I'll feed the queue and the people they go home to.

mechanism: A imitates each newly revealed source of B's cake success and turns it into a new measure to exceed.
confusable: Unlike switching goals randomly, each adopted quality must be B's apparently powerful behavior.
comparison: S226-a shifts from minimalist decoration to portion generosity and reach; S226-b shifts from calm to detailed damage questions.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
